t: Masala chicken rice is the perfect high protein meal for Gym Rats
d: Masala chicken rice is the perfect high protein meal for Gym Rats. Its tailored specifically to be low fat, low carb and high protein for gym goers. It’s not only easy to make it’s also tasty af. Made with chicken breast and rice (you can use any rice basmati is not a necessity) it’s plenty flavourful and when had with a side salad it’s a complete meal giving you 55gms of protein, appropriate amount of carbs and you need little to no fat to make it. | Ingredients: | Chicken Breast - 250gms | Rice - 1/4 of rice | Butter - 1/2 teaspoon | Chilli powder - 1/2 tbsp | Fennel powder- 1/2 teaspoon | Garam masala- 1/4 teaspoon | Salt - 1/2 tbsp | Onion - 1 thinly sliced | Tomato - 1 chopped | Green Chillies - 2 | GG paste - 1/2 tbsp | Curd - 1 tbsp | Instructions: | In a pan add some butter, fennel seeds and immediately add the onions, keep the heat in medium. Once the onions become soft add GG paste and Green Chillies, coriander leaves. Saute them nicely before adding all the spices with curd. Sauté them until they form a thick paste and once it achieve that consistency add your chicken breast and sauté them for a minute. Now add your washed rice, two cups of water and mix it well. Now cover and cook it for twenty minutes on low heat. Check in between to see it the bottom is burning. After twenty minutes your rice and chicken will be in perfect and will be ready to devour. Squeeze some lime and devour it with some side salad 😋

t: This one pot Chinese chicken rice is the ultimate one pot chicken and rice recipe you...
d: This one pot Chinese chicken rice is the ultimate one pot chicken and rice recipe you need if you’re a gym rat looking to lose weight or build muscle. The chicken breast gives you plenty protein like 60gms of them while the rice provides carb which is calculated to be under 600 kcal as a meal. This one pot Chinese chicken rice is inspired by the claypot rice of china and other Asian countries. But since we’re aiming for muscle growth and not crispy rice layer, this recipe uses very less oil but the flavour is out of this world, just the perfect meal which you whip up under 30 which is less than your takeout delivery times so let me know if you try this. | Ingredients: | Chicken breast - 250gms boneless skinless | Rice - 1/4 cup 50grams | Soy sauce - 2 tbsp | Chilli powder/flakes - 1/2tbsp (coz we’re Indian) | Garlic - 5 cloves | Green chillies - 1 thinly sliced | Spring onions - thinly sliced | Salt - 1/2 tsp | Pepper powder - 1/2tbsp | MSG - optional | Chilli oil - optional ( I didn’t add but generally added in this style) | Instructions: | In a pan add 2ml of oil and once hot add the chopped garlic, once they’re fragrant add the washed basmati rice and toast them slightly before adding water. Now cover and cook for ten minutes in low heat(the lowest your induction goes) In the meanwhile in a bowl add chicken, pepper powder, salt, soy sauce and red chilli powder. Mix them well and let them marinate until the rice cooks for ten minutes. If you have more time chop the spring onions, green chillies. Once the rice hits the ten minutes mark, add the marinated chicken, 1/4 cup of water. Cover and cook for ten to twelve minutes. Check if the rice is done and if the rice is done the chicken is done. Now it’s time to garnish and this is the fun part. First add your green chillies, spring onion, chilli oil (optional), soy sauce and mix the chicken and rice well. Every grain of rice should be coated with that brown caramelised soy sauce color. That’s it you got the most flavour ful chicken and rice you’ve ever tasted. Now devour it and I’ll see you with another recipe soon, Buhbyee ✨

t: The world dressed its illusions in soft light and sold them as salvation, and you—hungry...
d: The world dressed its illusions in soft light and sold them as salvation, and you—hungry, dreaming—believed. Now you sit among the ash, your skin singed by the fire you walked into with others who also believed. The fantasy wrung you out, left you hollow and humming with absence, yet you exist—still, quietly, like smoke that refuses to vanish. In your silence echoes the stunned detachment of Ben Lerner’s narrators, the quiet rupture of Han Kang’s women who disappear from the inside out, the archival grief of Valeria Luiselli’s lost children, and the paralyzing self-awareness of Wallace’s broken thinkers. What remains of you is not innocence but endurance, and in that, something stubbornly sacred. t: Most people think rest just means sleep, but true recovery goes beyond that
d: Most people think rest just means sleep, but true recovery goes beyond that. If you're constantly exhausted even after a full night's sleep, you might be missing other essential types of rest. 1. Physical Rest – Includes sleep, naps, stretching, and relaxation techniques to restore your body. 2. Mental Rest – Taking breaks from decision-making, overthinking, and constant problem-solving to clear your mind. 3. Emotional Rest – Setting boundaries, expressing your feelings, and spending time with people who don’t drain you. 4. Social Rest – Taking time away from toxic or demanding relationships and surrounding yourself with people who uplift you. 5. Sensory Rest – Reducing exposure to screens, bright lights, noise, and overstimulation to give your nervous system a break. 6. Creative Rest – Taking in inspiration without pressure—whether through nature, art, music, or simple curiosity. 7. Purposeful Rest – Engaging in activities that align with your values, give you a sense of fulfillment, or help you feel grounded. If you’re feeling drained even after sleeping well, you might need a different kind of rest. Which one do you need most right now? t: ⚠️Fun fact: Christopher Nolan’s Interstellar had a production budget of $165 million
d: ⚠️Fun fact: Christopher Nolan’s Interstellar had a production budget of $165 million. To make the film feel authentic, Nolan planted 500 acres of corn in Alberta, Canada, specifically for the scenes depicting the protagonist’s farm. The cost of planting the corn was around $100,000, but after filming, the crop was harvested and sold for a surprising profit of $162,000. This creative move not only added realism to the movie but also turned an unexpected profit from the production process. Interstellar went on to gross over $677 million worldwide, solidifying its success as one of Nolan’s most ambitious films and a testament to his preference for practical effects over CGI. d: The Magic of Binary to Decimal Conversion A Transistor Computer Display in Action Have you ever wondered how computers understand numbers? At their core, computers operate in binary (0s and 1s), but humans use decimal (0-9) for everyday calculations. This transformation from binary to decimal is fundamental in computing, and a transistor-based computer display makes this process visually captivating Transistor Computers: Bringing Binary to Life A transistor-based computer uses tiny semiconductor switches to represent these binary states ✅ 1 (ON) – Current flows ❌ 0 (OFF) – No current When displayed on a transistor computer display, you can see how binary numbers change in real-time, illuminating different sections based on power calculations. This visual representation helps demystify how digital systems compute and process data at lightning speed Why This Matters? From smartphones to AI, everything in modern technology relies on binary-to-decimal conversions. Here’s how to do it step by step: | 1. Lay the T-shirt Flat | - Spread the T-shirt out on a flat surface (like a table or bed), with the front side facing up. | - Smooth out any wrinkles to ensure a clean fold. | 2. Identify Three Points | - Imagine two straight lines: | - A horizontal line across the middle of the T-shirt. | - A vertical line running down from the shoulder to the bottom. | - The three points you’ll interact with are: | - **Point A**: On the shoulder, near the neckline. | - **Point B**: On the horizontal line, directly below Point A. | - **Point C**: At the bottom hem, aligned with Point B. | 3. Pinch Points A and B | - With one hand, pinch Point A (shoulder area). | - With your other hand, pinch Point B (middle of the T-shirt). | 4. Cross and Pinch Point C | - While holding Point A, cross your hand over to Point C (bottom hem) and pinch it. Your arms will cross. | 5. Uncross and Shake | - Uncross your arms while holding all three points. This action folds the T-shirt in half neatly. | 6. Fold Again | - Lay the folded T-shirt down and fold it once more to complete. | Practice Makes Perfect! | It might take a few tries to get the hang of it, but once mastered, you’ll be folding T-shirts in just seconds❤️ | [reels,2 second fold,erode]

t: Avoid these 5 mistakes👇 At first follow for more helpful videos
d: Avoid these 5 mistakes👇 At first follow @rr_aesthetic for more helpful videos. 1. Dieting with no muscles If you are skinny but you have a little tummy, you don't want to straight up go on a diet, because the main reason why you are out of shape is the lack of muscle, So to fix that, focus first on building muscle with a lean bulking protocol, then polish the end result with a mini fat loss phase. 2. Not tracking calories The only way to lose belly fat is to stay in a calorie deficit long enough for your body to lose fat. However, if you don't know how many calories you need to eat daily to get into a calorie deficit, you're just leaving your results up to luck. 3. Prioritizing cardio over weights Cardio has to be the most overrated tool for fat loss.Sure, being more active helps, but building more muscle will boost your metabolism, which will have you burn more calories at rest. For best results, focus the bulk of your efforts on weight training, and supplement with a little bit of cardio or daily steps on top. 4. Obsessing over ab workouts While training your core helps a bit with the definition, the bulk of your ab definition is going to be decided by how lean you are. For instance, although I wouldn't recommend it, I achieved my first shredded abs with a single ab workout 5. Neglecting sleep A lack of sleep has been shown to reduce fat loss results by up to 50%. That is quite literally insane, yet most people are not sleeping enough. t: Day 1 of 7 Days, 7 Egg Recipes For the first day let’s start with Chinese Steamed Eggs...
d: Day 1 of 7 Days, 7 Egg Recipes For the first day let’s start with Chinese Steamed Eggs, even though throughout Asia you can find Steamed eggs and All of them are almost the same recipe, you know I love the Chinese. This was a recipe I say Inga Lam making in a video with Andrew on the channel About to eat. This uses milk but you can water also. Join me and make these seven recipes and let me know if you like it. Remember eggs has very good protein and cheaper too, so don’t hate it before you try it shawty. Ingredients: Eggs - Three Milk - 150ml (for every egg 50ml) Salt - 1/2 tablespoon Spring onions/coriander/mint - to garnish Chilli oil - to garnish (optional) Procedure : Crack open three eggs in a bowl and salt to it. Whisk vigorously until well combined. Now add 150ml of milk and beat it until it forms a uniform consistency. Cover the bowl with aluminium foil or a lid. In an idly steamer or a makeshift (like the one I’m using) steam the eggs for Ten minutes. Once done rest uncovered for 6-8 minutes. Now make cuts and garnish with chilli oil and green herb of your choice. Now you can eat it as it is but you can also mix it with rice and it’ll be good(children will love it because is texture is soooo good).

t: Okay, first of all you need to accept the fact that 3D animated websites are hard and...
d: Okay, first of all you need to accept the fact that 3D animated websites are hard and complex to develop. Its not a figma design to be delivered in a single day. It takes more time more complex code. However if your looking to use tools and platforms, it can be simplified even for beginners. 1. Use Web Builders with 3D Support Some website builders support 3D elements and animations without needing deep coding knowledge: Webflow: Offers an intuitive drag-and-drop interface and supports 3D transformations and animations. You can import 3D models and use Webflow’s interactions to animate them. Semplice: A portfolio-focused platform that allows for 3D animations and high levels of customization. Framer: Another easy-to-use website builder with support for complex animations and 3D effects. 2. Use 3D Web Editors Web-based 3D editors let you design, animate, and export 3D objects for the web: Spline: An easy-to-use tool that allows you to create 3D objects and interactive animations. You can export your work directly as code for websites. Tinkercad: A beginner-friendly 3D modeling tool that lets you create basic 3D objects and export them for use on websites. 3.3D Tools for Specific Elements If you just want to integrate a few 3D elements into your website, you can use: Lottie: Allows you to use lightweight animations (JSON-based) created in After Effects. These can include pseudo-3D effects and are very easy to integrate into websites. Canva: Offers some 3D graphic elements that you can use for banners or image-based 3D effects. #websitedevelopment #websitecompany #websiteinspiration #websitedesigner.

t: This high protein soy burger(it has 50 grams of protein) is the stuff you want to put in...
d: This high protein soy burger(it has 50 grams of protein) is the stuff you want to put in your mouth again and again, not the freaky way you think rascal. It’s cheap, easy to make, doesn’t need too many dishes. The sauce is very simple here to keep it realistic but tbh when I make burgers for me I only use ketchup leftover from takeout, you do you - go crazy I say. Ingredients: Soya chunks - 100gms after reconstituted in water Green chillies- 4 Saunf/perunseeragam - one teaspoon Salt to taste Oil - just a splash Chilli powder - a splash of Garlic - three cloves Maida - three tablespoons Procedure: Reconstitute the soya chunks in warm water. After ten minutes, squeeze the water of them and into a mixer jar it goes. Add the green chillies and saunf/perunseeragam, blend until well shredded now add a splash of water and maida to combine them well, besan flour also works. In a hot pan add a splash of oil and in goes the soya mixture, form round patties as thin as possible. Cover and cook for seven minutes each side in medium heat. Flip and press it down to get the other side also charred. Now it’s a matter of assembly. I used tomatoes, onion and cucumber because that’s what I had lying around. For the sauce, combine some mayo, ketchup(optional- minced garlic, hot sauce and lil of herbs). Now it’s time to serve and eat! Let me know in the comments if you ATE today!.

5 facts about boxing | 1.	Oldest Combat Sport: Boxing is one of the oldest sports in the world, with evidence of its practice dating back to ancient Egypt around 3000 BCE. It later became part of the ancient Olympic Games in Greece in 688 BCE. | 2.	12-Round Limit: Modern boxing matches are typically limited to 12 rounds. This change was introduced in the 1980s for safety reasons after a tragic death in the ring during a 15-round fight. | 3.	Weight Classes: To ensure fairness, boxers compete in weight classes, such as lightweight, middleweight, and heavyweight. The first organized weight class system was introduced in the 19th century. | 4.	Muhammad Ali’s Rope-a-Dope: Muhammad Ali’s famous “rope-a-dope” strategy, used in the 1974 “Rumble in the Jungle” against George Foreman, involved leaning against the ropes to tire out his opponent before launching his counterattack. | 5.	Longest Boxing Match: The longest boxing match on record lasted 110 rounds over 7 hours and 19 minutes in 1893 between Andy Bowen and Jack Burke. The fight ended in a draw when both men were too exhausted to continue.

t: FACING HAIRLOSS ? ⤵️ I am not a doctor guys don't blindly follow what I did I am just...
d: FACING HAIRLOSS ? ⤵️ I am not a doctor guys don't blindly follow what I did I am just sharing my experience always have a consultation with a doctor The hair follicles I lost is gone for ever unless I do a transplant But with proper routine which I followed I gained 10 x more density than before on existing follicles Without doing a transplant ----------- SOLUTION -------------- 🚫 NOT TO DO LIST ❌ However, I acknowledge some mistakes I made that accelerated my hair loss, particularly in my early 20s: - Overusing caps, especially during workouts - Not wearing a soft kerchief before putting on helmets - Not washing my hair at least twice a week - Using a high-speed hair dryer too close to my head - Using bathing soaps instead of proper hair care products - Neglecting to address my dandruff issues adequately ✅ TO DO LIST ✅ On the other hand, here are some beneficial steps I took to regrow my hair and fighting the androgenic alopecia which is male pattern baldness - Shaving my head before beginning any treatment - Incorporating more hair-nutritious foods like curry leaves, almonds, pumpkin seeds, and whole eggs into my diet - Seeking guidance from a doctor and following a proper PRP routine - Using a vasodilator like minoxidil daily without fail under medical dosage - Opting for RO water or a drinking water for hair washing - Rinsing sweaty hair every day after workouts, using warm water instead of shampoo ---- I CAN FEEL YOU MACHA --- But listen After trying various methods for years and feeling disheartened, I resorted to covering my head with a cap. I lost hope and thought I had exhausted all options I even shaved my head started bulking to chasing rock's path 😂 but then I told myself, Let's give it one last try. As I always say, when you dedicate yourself completely - your time, effort, and yes, money - to something, you can achieve anything not only hair but your body mind anything and everything It's all takes a pure effort time and dedication towards something Eat well, stay active. . . . #hair #hairgrowth #reels #viralvideos.

t: Forget 100 years… this the best invention since the beginning of time Created by: *Tom...
d: Forget 100 years… this the best invention since the beginning of time Created by: @kevin_heckart *Tom and Jerry* is a classic animated series created by William Hanna and Joseph Barbera in 1940. It focuses on the rivalry between Tom, a house cat, and Jerry, a clever mouse, with each episode revolving around Tom’s attempts to catch Jerry. The show is famous for its slapstick humor and physical comedy, where chaotic chases and clever tricks drive the plot. The series relies heavily on visual gags, with little to no dialogue, making it accessible to audiences of all ages. Tom’s elaborate traps and schemes are often outsmarted by Jerry, leading to humorous situations. The timing, sound effects, and expressive animation are key to the show’s comedic success. The animation, particularly in the early episodes, is detailed and expressive, with hand-drawn visuals that bring the characters to life. The accompanying music and sound design play a crucial role in enhancing the humor, adding tension, and building comedic moments throughout. *Tom and Jerry* has gone through various adaptations, including films and reboots, though the original Hanna-Barbera episodes are considered classics. The basic cat-and-mouse formula has remained consistent, keeping the series relevant to new generations of viewers. Ultimately, *Tom and Jerry* is a timeless cartoon that entertains through its universal themes of rivalry and humor. Its ability to convey emotion and humor without dialogue has made it a lasting favorite across cultures and eras. #memes #memesdaily #funny #meme #lol #fyp.

t: We never know what we have until it’s gone … We never miss the sun until winter comes...
d: We never know what we have until it’s gone … We never miss the sun until winter comes around. We never appreciate our health until we become sick. We can all relate to this, and yet we cannot seem to figure out why we take things for granted. This isn’t something we do intentionally. It’s because our brain is designed to adapt to new changes and make them the norm. But our inherent desires of want and need - the same feeling that many thousand years ago was critical for human survival, persist throughout our lives. There’s only one way to turn things around and that is simply being more aware of what you have and practice gratitude. Be happy that you have a roof over your head. That there’s food in the fridge. That you can take every step effortlessly. That you woke up today. Once you’re thankful for what you have, you’ll end up having more. But if you keep concentrating on what you don’t have, you will never have enough. . . . #motivation #inspiration #gratefulness #gratitude #selfimprovement #selfdevelopment #begrateful #grateful #mindset.

d: Muscle Growth Mistakes👇 I was finally able to gain muscle only after fixing these 4 big mistakes... ✅ SAVE this post to boost your muscle growth! I FIXED THESE: 1️⃣ Using the same weights every week Muscles need a reason to grow. If you don’t keep increasing the weight or reps, they will stay the same. 2️⃣ Rest periods are too short between sets Doing 5 quality sets with 2-4 minutes of rest will yield the same results as 10 sets with 1-2 minutes of rest. HIIT training is not effective for building muscle. 3️⃣ Overloading on junk volume Don’t waste your time and keep it simple - Pick 5 exercises for a muscle group. - Do 3-4 quality sets for each exercise. - Train one muscle group a day. If you are not seeing muscle growth, it’s about quality, not quantity. 4️⃣ Fear of temporary body fat Gaining muscle or “recomping” in a calorie deficit won’t work long-term. You need temporary surpluses (lean gaining) and cut back down later. HONORABLE TIP: Lean gaining can sound scary, but understand this: If you are a new lifter, you will likely gain 70% muscle and only 30% fat :) ✅ Follow for daily fitness tips and workouts. Quality will always outgrow quantity - learn the principles & you will grow in less time. t: Nisarga Art Hub, a community and cultural center in Ernakulam, India, has been completed...
d: Nisarga Art Hub, a community and cultural center in Ernakulam, India, has been completed by locally-based architects Wallmakers in celebration of the traditional culture of the state of Kerala. The project was created for a family of musicians, and designed as a space where the community could gather and experience art. Sited near a paddy field, the art hub draws inspiration from the traditional Kerala roofs that dot the surrounding landscape. These roofs are characterized by their sloping, tiled surfaces, which provide excellent insulation and temperature regulation. However, as Kerala roofs can also lend dark interiors, the team sought to strategically break open the roof to ensure natural light. Wallmakers defines its Nisarga Art Hub by its Kerald rooftop, incorporating both skylights which serve a dual-purpose. The architects‘ solution was to incorporate the series of skylights into the roof, angled at 35 degrees to match the angle of an open-air amphitheater. This creates a unique, occupiable surface where the skylights serve as seating for an audience, while a series of wooden planks placed over a swimming pool creates a stage for open-air concerts accommodating nearly eighty people. t: Explanation:-👉The function Ennama_keezha_satham is defined with a single parameter...
d: Explanation:-👉The function Ennama_keezha_satham is defined with a single parameter vadivelu, which represents a string of characters. 👉The if statement checks if the length of the string vadivelu is equal to 0, which means that there are no characters left to print. ( This is the base case for the recursion) 👉If the if statement is not true, the else block is executed, 👉which prints the first character of the string using the print function with the end parameter set to an empty string. This is done to print each character on the same line. 👉The function is then called recursively with the vadivelu string sliced from the second character onwards 👉(vadivelu[1:]). This means that the function will be called again, but with a smaller string than before, until the base case is reached (i.e., the length of the string is 0). 👉When the base case is reached, the function returns and the recursion unwinds, meaning that each previous call to the function completes its execution. 👉Overall, this recursive function prints each character of the input string one by one on a single line, using recursion to call itself with a smaller string until there are no more characters left to print. This is just one example of how recursion can be used in programming. #recursion #python #programmingmemes #itmemes #annauniversity #srmuniversity #psgtech #chennai #zoho #infosys.

t: It's a convo between me and my dad once i cried to him through phone call , but that day...
d: It's a convo between me and my dad once i cried to him through phone call , but that day, i don't know this recording is gonna be my only gem for the rest of my life. The man who stands for me in every situation, whatever his mood, whatever his pain, whatever his sorrows... Loss is normal in life, but this loss can't be replaced by anything.... Whenever i feel low, his words, his voice, his thinking, his ideas, everything cheered me up. Now the life is just like a ship sailing without captain, Miss you Daddy... Love you a lot... It's not like a sympathy post. Every loss in our lives will teach us lessons. This loss taught me a lot... So please take care of ur loved ones. Don't let them feel low or stressed... This video may make someone cry or make someone cheering, but atlast onething as my dad said, Don't lose hope on yourself. #spreadlove #daddy #love #hope #life #hero #lifequotes.
